summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K responding to B3 Letter 293/2026-SLE, which sought clarification of a Valor Econômico article reporting that the São Paulo State Public Prosecutor's Office recommended suspending Braskem Idesa's financial restructuring and appointing a judicial administrator over Braskem's extrajudicial reorganization. The challenged plan comprises US$415M in financing plus a US$71M Braskem capital contribution to the Mexican subsidiary, with roughly US$800M of funds potentially committed; ~US$230M and ~US$49M of the first two tranches are already funded. Dissident international bond and debenture holders petitioned São Paulo's 2nd Bankruptcy Court; no ruling yet. Watch Brazilian court rulings, Chapter 11 coordination and intercreditor asset-diversion risk.
